svg.title: Experience: Renault Digital, SNCF Connect & Tech, Zanalys, Easivio, Thales
svg.desc: Renault Digital, Senior Software Engineer · Freelance (Mar 2025 — Present): Technical lead on the multi-brand Renault, Dacia and Alpine mobile app: architecture, remote internationalisation, CI/CD and quality. SNCF Connect & Tech, Senior Developer Dart / Flutter (Aug 2022 — Mar 2025): Architecture for a white-label ticket inspection and payment app. JustGo and Airweb: native integrations, scanning, unit, widget and golden tests, through to production launch. Zanalys, Senior Flutter developer · Healthcare (Since Jan 2023): A medical solution for the early detection of rare diseases: application audit, real-time chat, biometric identification, notifications and error handling. Easivio, Co-founder (2019 — 2022): Mobile widgets displayed on Android TV through the Easivio TV companion app, and Pixhella, a photo-sharing network with a print service. Thales, Software engineering · Team management (Oct 2014 — Nov 2019): Head of the SmartDisplay competence centre, a 60-person department. Delivery lead on ALLIOT international parcel tracking for La Poste and Swiss Post.
